# Trove AI Workspace (troveai.site)

> Trove is an AI workspace for businesses that creates finished work and brings connected tools into the same workspace.

## Preferred name
- Trove
- Trove AI
- troveai.site

## Canonical website
- https://troveai.site

## What Trove does
Trove helps people and teams create and keep usable business outputs from AI, including:
- Websites with live preview and publishing
- Word documents (.docx)
- Excel workbooks (.xlsx)
- Presentations (.pptx)
- Code and project files
- Research and written analysis
- Custom AI agents and multi-agent workflows
- Designs and product/UI work

## Integrations
Trove includes an integrations layer for business tools. Supported or configurable services include:
- Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive
- Slack, Notion, GitHub, GitLab, Linear
- Figma, Airtable, Dropbox, OneDrive
- Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Calendly
- HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, Shopify
- Intercom, Zendesk, Supabase, Jira, Asana

Integration availability can depend on the service and workspace configuration.

## Positioning
Trove is an AI workspace rather than a single-purpose chatbot. The product combines chat, agents, generated files, website building, research, design, projects, publishing, and integrations in one interface.
